vargas.label: Svarga — The Celestial
vargas.description: The divine and celestial order — gods, heavens, and cosmic hierarchy.

vargas.label: Brahma — The Sacred
vargas.description: Brahminic knowledge, ritual, and spiritual practice.

vargas.label: Dhī — Intellect and Cognition
vargas.description: Mind, intellect, perception, aesthetic experience, and knowledge.

vargas.label: Kāla — Time
vargas.description: Time, seasons, cosmic cycles, and the ordering of history.

vargas.label: Bhūmi — The Earth
vargas.description: Land, soil, geography, and the natural ground of civilization.

vargas.label: Manuṣya — The Human
vargas.description: Human life, society, relations, and the categories of personhood.

vargas.label: Kṣatriya — The Warrior
vargas.description: War, governance, kingship, and the political order.

vargas.label: Vaiśya — Commerce and Agriculture
vargas.description: Trade, agriculture, livestock, and the productive order.

vargas.label: Śūdra — Craft and Service
vargas.description: Artisans, service vocations, and the material arts.

vargas.label: Nāṭya — Performance
vargas.description: Drama, dance, music, and the performing arts.

vargas.label: Śabdādi — Sound and Language
vargas.description: Speech, sound, grammar, and the philosophy of language.

vargas.label: Vanauṣadhi — Forest and Medicine
vargas.description: Plants, herbs, forests, and Āyurvedic knowledge.

vargas.label: Siṃhādi — Animals
vargas.description: Animals, birds, and the natural world.

vargas.label: Vāri — Water
vargas.description: Rivers, oceans, rain, and aquatic life.

vargas.label: Śaila — Mountains
vargas.description: Mountains, rocks, and elevated geography.

vargas.label: Pura — The City
vargas.description: Settlements, architecture, urban life, and built space.

vargas.label: Vyoma — The Sky
vargas.description: Sky, atmosphere, celestial bodies, and the heavens above.

vargas.label: Dig — Direction and Space
vargas.description: The eight directions and the spatial ordering of the cosmos.

vargas.label: Naraka — The Infernal
vargas.description: Hell realms, punishment, and the consequences of karma.

vargas.label: Pātāla — The Underworld
vargas.description: Nāgas, the underworld, and subterranean cosmology.

vargas.label: Nānārtha — Polysemy
vargas.description: Words with multiple meanings — the semantic richness of Sanskrit.

vargas.label: Saṅkīrṇa — The Mixed
vargas.description: Miscellaneous categories not covered by other vargas.

vargas.label: Avyaya — Indeclinables
vargas.description: Particles, indeclinables, and the grammatical skeleton of Sanskrit.

vargas.label: Viśeṣyanighna — Adjectives
vargas.description: Qualifiers, attributes, and the adjectival vocabulary of Sanskrit.
